observed_problem: Profile Completeness is structurally explicit but current Core guidance does not sufficiently distinguish a reasoned ChatGPT completeness judgment from a ceremonial status row. Empty discovery/evidence references can be legitimate for a negative search result, but the record currently has no canonical agent-review expectation explaining what was searched, what was not found, what remains uncertain, and why the edition is ready or limited.
expected_behavior: ChatGPT remains the authority for research-completeness judgment. The production guide/checklist must require a substantive per-obligation rationale, explicit unresolved limitations, and a distinction between searched-with-no-material-result and not-yet-searched. Deterministic validation checks record structure/traceability and must not pretend to prove open-ended research completeness or impose source/story quotas.
actual_behavior: The agent-first authority/bootstrap and Issue Prevention Checklist now require substantive search/coverage rationale, gap-fill/negative-result accounting, residual uncertainty and reasoned readiness while retaining deterministic validation only for structure/traceability.

provenance.human_review_reference: User premise correction and ChatGPT-first pre-approval re-audit, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implemented by WU-012A/D: require ChatGPT to record meaningful search/coverage rationale and limitations, while keeping completeness qualitative and avoiding arbitrary machine proof or source-count quotas.
